verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API accepts password='123456'(6 chars) with HTTP 200, violating documented constraint '8 <= len(password) <= 64'. Source code confirms actual bounds are MinPasswordLength=6 and MaxPasswordLength=72 (defaults in component_param.go). Error messages show '6 <= value <= 72' when rejecting invalid passwords. This is a documentation mismatch defect - implementation correctly enforces 6-72, but constraint incorrectly states 8-64. Per developer cognition, 'Documentation-behavior consistency' issues are confirmed defects (maintainers fix docs to match verified behavior).
